name: Bank KYC Suspension & Phishing Link
description: Scammers send urgent SMS messages claiming the victim's bank account or net banking will be deactivated within 24 hours unless KYC documents are updated on a spoofed link.
risk_contribution: High Base Weight (85-95) with Impersonation + Link synergy.
limitations: May miss completely brand-new spoofed domain formats if no URL heuristics match.
example_synthetic: Dear SBI User, your YONO account is suspended today due to KYC incomplete. Click http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz to verify immediately.
safe_action: Never update KYC via SMS links. Visit your home bank branch or use the official verified banking mobile app.

name: UPI 'Enter PIN to Receive Money' Cashback Fraud
description: Perpetrators trick victims into entering their UPI PIN on Google Pay/PhonePe/Paytm claiming it is required to receive a cashback, reward, or marketplace payment.
risk_contribution: High Base Weight (80-92) with Payment Coercion synergy.
tactics: Reversal of UPI protocol fundamentals, psychological lure of instant money.
limitations: Voice call negotiations accompanying the request may happen out-of-band.
example_synthetic: Congratulations! You have received ₹5,000 PhonePe cashback. Click here and enter your UPI PIN to credit funds to your account.
safe_action: Remember: UPI PIN is ONLY required to SEND money, never to RECEIVE money.

name: Fake Electricity Disconnection Panic
description: Victims receive threatening SMS claiming their power supply will be cut off tonight at 9:30 PM due to unpaid electricity bill, instructing them to call a fraudulent mobile number.
tactics: Time-sensitive fear of darkness/disconnection, informal mobile phone contact.
limitations: Genuine power cut notices may occasionally share urgent maintenance alerts.
example_synthetic: Dear Consumer, your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM from power office. Contact Electricity Officer at 9876543210 immediately.
safe_action: Check bill status solely on the official State Electricity DISCOM website or mobile app.

name: Remote Access App Support Hijack
description: Fraudsters posing as bank or wallet support convince victims to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or QuickSupport to 'assist' with a failed transaction, gaining full device screen access.
risk_contribution: Critical Base Weight (88-98) with Remote Control synergy.
tactics: Pretending technical assistance, screen mirroring for OTP interception.
limitations: Legitimate enterprise IT support tools share similar naming conventions.
example_synthetic: Sir, to process your Paytm refund of Rs 1,200, please install AnyDesk from Play Store and provide the 9-digit code for verification.
safe_action: Never install remote desktop apps at the request of an unverified incoming caller.

name: Part-Time Task & Telegram Deposit Scam
description: Offers lucrative daily earnings for simple tasks (liking YouTube videos, rating hotels), then demands 'prepaid task deposits' or crypto transfers to unlock earnings.
tactics: Sunk-cost fallacy, initial small payout hook, shifting to private Telegram channels.
limitations: Initial conversation text may appear polite and benign.
example_synthetic: Part-time job offer: Earn ₹3,000 - ₹8,000 daily by liking YouTube videos from home. Join our Telegram channel @DailyJobTask to start today.
safe_action: No legitimate employer asks candidates to pay money or deposit security fees to receive a salary.

name: Customs Courier / FedEx Narcotics Impersonation
description: Impersonators claim a parcel sent in the victim's name containing illegal contraband (narcotics, fake passports) has been intercepted by Customs/Police, demanding funds for clearance.
tactics: Digital arrest intimidation, fake police uniform video calls, coercive extortion.
limitations: Scam evolves heavily during interactive voice calls.
example_synthetic: Your FedEx parcel #FDX9082 containing illegal substances is detained by Customs. Legal warrant issued by Crime Branch. Pay clearance fee immediately to avoid arrest.
safe_action: Real police or customs departments never demand online payments or issue digital arrest warrants over Skype/WhatsApp.

name: Digital Arrest Law Enforcement Video Extortion
description: Criminals posing as CBI, ED, or Cyber Police officers threaten victims with fake non-bailable arrest warrants, coercing them into staying on Skype/WhatsApp video calls for hours while transferring savings to 'government escrow accounts'.
risk_contribution: Critical Base Weight (90-100) with Law Enforcement Extortion synergy.
tactics: Fake court seals, staged police backdrop rooms, psychological isolation and extreme fear.
limitations: Victims are often pressured not to hang up or discuss the call with family.
example_synthetic: CBI Cyber Crime Cell: A parcel containing narcotics under your Aadhaar has been intercepted. You are placed under digital arrest on Skype video call. Stay on call or police team will arrest you.
safe_action: Indian law enforcement NEVER conducts trials or arrests via video call. Disconnect immediately and call the national cybercrime helpline 1930.

name: VIP Stock IPO & High-Yield Ponzi Scheme
description: Victims are added to private WhatsApp/Telegram trading groups promising 500% guaranteed returns on institutional IPO allocations, luring them into depositing funds into fraudulent merchant accounts.
risk_contribution: High Base Weight (80-92) with Private Channel synergy.
tactics: Fabricated profit screenshots, fake group participants cheering earnings, urgency to deposit.
limitations: Initial lure links may look like legitimate investment discussion groups.
example_synthetic: VIP Institutional Stock Group: Guaranteed 500% returns in 7 days on pre-allotted IPO stocks. Join our exclusive WhatsApp trading channel @WealthVIP to start with Rs 5,000.
safe_action: Always verify brokers on the official SEBI registry (sebi.gov.in). Never transfer investment money to personal or unverified UPI VPAs.
